label: For "Collateral Valuation & Haircut Monitoring": Revalue pledged collateral continuously and set haircuts so the bank is not under-secured when prices fall or liquidity dries up. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Back-test on calm markets misses stressed haircuts.
